body:
Groups eight Element Color Editor DOM references in the existing app-owned `els` table, assigned at their original const-query sites. The periodic-table factory excludes the retired Workbench launcher input while app-owned wiring preserves the supported legacy button, at the same late registration point and in the same order. No new controller or helper is introduced.

The actual count is **19 → 18** after launcher-input exclusion, then **18 → 11** after grouping: **ten used non-DOM inputs + els = eleven**. Every non-DOM input has real references, including `ATOM_SYMBOL_TO_Z`; none is removed or hidden to claim ten. Mutable-cache conversions remain **41 integrated**, tracked `let` **265 → 265**. App.js has **33,070 lines / 1,181 top-level function declarations**. The authorized factory declarations and legacy-launcher relocation have app **+26/−25** and periodic module **+33/−42** changes. Independent inverse audit reproduces both original sources exactly and confirms all 1,190 existing app function declarations are byte-identical, all 19 periodic function declarations remain, original null/query timing is preserved, and no other logic changes.

### Manual verification

The native Workbench **Panels → Properties → Look → Colors → Edit…** route through `openElementColors` opens the editor in light and dark themes. The original launcher remains connected and wired in both legacy themes. Both native entry paths pass on the actual pushed integration prerequisite and this candidate. The direct unchanged `periodic_table.py --base-root` gate produced **36 captures per source**, exactly equal on tagged and proposed trees: element selection, input/change, per-element/all reset, pending-picker preset save, imported appearance, close/reopen, Escape, resize/backdrop, session restore, lazy rendering and stopped preview loop across four launch/theme cases.

The fresh removed-markup census inspected 2,188 app lexical bindings, 296 direct literal-ID caches and 41 canonical els fields. It classified 25 retired IDs / 26 app references, plus eight module/slider/listener cache IDs and six transient/wiring-only IDs from an all-module startup trace. All 33 cache IDs and four transient IDs were observed connected in legacy; two unqueried transient IDs retain an explicit source-inference limitation. Keep legacy backing controls. The source, use sites, native routes, collector diagnostics and limitations are preserved in `tests/baselines/evidence/stage3/colors/preflight/`. Issue #14 stays open for broader retired-UI cleanup; the Workbench live identity set still excludes its old launcher, and all 52 identity slots/legacy compatibility remain intact.

Completed local checks: `make check`, **433 JavaScript / 29 Python** unit tests; **102 unchanged captures twice**, exact serialized repeat and zero diagnostic pixel changes in **1,033.61 s**. The eight identity reports were independently re-evaluated with the current shipped assertion: all **52 slots** retained Workbench **47 live + 5 known absent** / legacy **48 + 4** composition and every minimum. Actual presented checks 39/32; mode 408/9 (404/6 observed beyond explicit calls); panel 669–1064; DOM 2967–5430; restore 1 in each context. Local runtime: macOS arm64 / Chromium 145.0.7632.6. Original environment/collector diagnostic logs and limitations remain preserved. This is local verification, not the CI merge gate.

This branch also durably carries Symmetry #22's independently verified first-pass [CI 39034824420](https://github.com/evangelistalab/vibemol/actions/runs/39034824420): 34/3/37, 102 unchanged captures twice, 52 slots × eight contexts, all minima/checks/unit/WebKit, merged/pushed as `04e01ad`. Full CI was 31.9833 min vs 132.93 min (75.94% less / 4.156×), Looks 21.65 min, both material paths passed, #11 vibration after the second download. Original #20's failed 33/4 run and issue #21's paired 442/12 diagnostics remain separate and never serve as merge evidence.

**Own first-pass ordinary CI conjunction independently verified:** [run 39039061120 attempt 1](https://github.com/evangelistalab/vibemol/actions/runs/39039061120), frozen head `37200658972b658c0ef4c101efe5d993d39d7c18`, base `04e01ad`, actual checkout `c354eca81cd05fad178deddcf9bb068ce233bf4c`, exact tested tree `a36a574d2fa7b3a612c2602c0453d41259978537`. All eleven jobs passed; all nine original ZIP digests matched GitHub. Both shipped joins were independently recomputed with validated source/run identity. All 37 suites ran once: **34 passed / 3 specified failures**, read directly from raw Escape, Coordinates Delete and **#11 trajectory-after-second-download** workflows. Vibration export was not reached in Smoke. `edit_tool.py` passed uninstrumented in **86.72 s** and its log has no numeric-width readback. Issue #21 remains carried and is not a fourth accepted failure. Both 102 unchanged-golden captures matched and repeated exactly, with zero diagnostic pixel changes. All 52 slots × 8 contexts retained Workbench 47 live + 5 absent / legacy 48 + 4 and every current firing minimum: actual presented 39/32, mode 408/9 (404/6 observer checks), panel 783–1127, DOM 3104–5470, restore 1 each. Checks 433 JS/29 Python and WebKit passed; baseline recording remained normally skipped.

Looks completed both Studio and Properties material-families paths in **1,951.74 s / 32.53 min**, with no timeout; `#appearanceMaterialPreset` did not recur and its risk remains open. Actual runtime: Linux x86_64, Chromium 156.0.8078.4 / Playwright 1.64.0, ANGLE Vulkan SwiftShader(Subzero). Whole sharded CI was **2,018 s / 33.6333 min** vs 132.93 min: **74.70% less / 3.952×**, eight cold-cache misses. Looks was the critical worker; Smoke was not critical. The diagnostic never supplies merge evidence. All original accepted failures remain intact. No workflow, shipped test/assertion/wait, fixture, golden, QA bridge or unrelated production file changed. One whole-stage boundary soak remains after the exact-head merge and integration push.
